description:
Mao Xiangling ( Chinese : 卯香菱 Mǎo Xiānglíng ) is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact .

She is the Head Chef at the Wanmin Restaurant and runs it alongside her father Chef Mao . As a chef, Xiangling isn't afraid to try out different recipes or "exotic" ingredients, making her dishes sometimes quite unique.
role_summary: Mao Xiangling ( Chinese : 卯香菱 Mǎo Xiānglíng ) is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Dough-Fu
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to five consecutive spear strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Guoba Attack
talents.description: Summons Guoba , who will continuously breathe fire at opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG .

talents.name: Pyronado
talents.description: Displaying her mastery over both fire and polearms, Xiangling sends a Pyronado whirling around her. The Pyronado will move with your character for the ability's duration, dealing Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path.

talents.name: Crossfire
talents.description: Increases the flame range of Guoba by 20%.

talents.name: Beware, It's Super Hot!
talents.description: When Guoba Attack 's effects end, Guoba leaves a chili pepper on the spot where it disappeared. Picking up a chili pepper increases ATK by 10% for 10s.

talents.name: Chef de Cuisine
talents.description: When Xiangling cooks an ATK-boosting dish perfectly, she has a 12% chance to receive double the product.

c1.name: Crispy Outside, Tender Inside
c1.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Opponents hit by Guoba's attacks have their Pyro RES reduced by 15% for 6s. This constellation also applies to some Wildlife . Forest Boars in Serenitea Pots also appear to have their Pyro RES reduced, although they cannot be killed.

c2.name: Oil Meets Fire
c2.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Advanced Properties The last attack in a Normal Attack sequence applies the Implode status onto the opponent for 2s. An explosion will occur once this duration ends, dealing 75% of Xiangling's ATK as AoE Pyro DMG . Although cats , dogs , and Serenitea Pot animals cannot take damage, they can be briefly set on fire with this Constellation, unlike other sources of Pyro. c3.name: Deepfry
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Pyronado by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Slowbake
c4.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Pyronado 's duration is increased by 40%. With this constellation, Pyronado will last 14 seconds.

c5.name: Guoba Mad
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Guoba Attack by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Condensed Pyronado
c6.effect: Description Gameplay Notes For the duration of Pyronado , all party members receive a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus . This effect will not buff Xiangling's own Pyronado when cast.
